comment: Updated controls: a shared pack. Picking an item up hands it straight to the hero who gains most from it (slot hand = melee weapon, range = ranged weapon, ammo = arrows or bullets for a ranged weapon, ring = protection for the worst-protected hero without one); what a hero puts down is offered to the others the same way. 'heroes' are name prefixes (nomad = any nomad). Items not listed stay in the shared pack. Edit freely.

5.note: a broadsword +2 (cluebook: worth 800 XP); damage assumed like a longsword +2

8.note: a two-handed sword: the strong fighters only (guess)

11.note: cluebook: Flint is the only character who uses axes

7.note: cluebook: only Tasslehoff can use the hoopak and its sling

9.note: a spear: Caramon throws it (one shot each); cluebook: Caramon is the only character who can use spears

17.note: a throwing axe: Flint throws it (one shot each)

14.note: cluebook: a quiver of arrows holds 20 shots

15.note: a quiver of arrows +2 holds 10 shots

16.note: the pouch of bullets +1 for the sling

52.note: cluebook: once a character has used a Ring of Protection he will not give it up

54.note: Braces of defence AC2 (assumed to help a little more than the rings)

19.note: Wyrmslayer: a +3 sword (+3 to hit and +3 damage), double damage against dragons. Caramon takes it first, otherwise Sturm; see Game::auto_equip.

70.note: Flame Tongue: a longsword +1, +4 against trolls, and a troll it kills is burned: it does not get up again (see Game::step_combat)

71.note: Plate armor: armor class 3 (only Caramon and Sturm can wear it); bonus is the armor class it gives

72.note: Shield +1 (the trolls' lair): improves the armor class by 1; only the fighters Sturm, Caramon, Riverwind and Tanis carry it
